Core Service Offering

Managed IT Services

Keep business technology maintained, monitored, and supported with defined service level agreements and structured response procedures.

Discuss Your Project Explore All Services

The Business Problem

Unnoticed server failures, unapplied security patches, slow troubleshooting during production incidents, and lack of systematic backup verification leading to data loss risks.

Suitable For

Businesses operating mission-critical applications that need proactive infrastructure oversight, scheduled maintenance, and clear escalation protocols without administrative overhead.

Deliverables & Scope

Managed IT Capabilities

System & Infrastructure Monitoring

Continuous tracking of server CPU, memory, disk, network throughput, and application health with configurable alerting thresholds.

Prometheus Grafana Datadog Alertmanager

Routine Maintenance & Patching

Scheduled operating system updates, database maintenance, software dependency patching, and TLS certificate renewal automation.

Security Patches SSL/TLS Renewal DB Vacuuming Log Rotation

Backup Verification & Disaster Recovery

Automated database snapshots, cross-region storage replication, and regular recovery drill verification to ensure recovery point objectives (RPO) are met.

Automated Snapshots Encrypted Backups Recovery Drills

Tiered Technical Support SLAs

Structured escalation paths for infrastructure incidents, prioritizing severe production blockers and providing documented root-cause postmortems.

SLA Tiers Escalation Runbooks Incident Reports
Frequently Asked Questions

Managed IT FAQs
